question: Should OpenClaw add a first-class WebChat shortcut/prompt-snippet browser, and which surface should own shortcut definitions and storage?
rationale: The UI need is understandable, but implementing it requires choosing a durable metadata/storage owner and deciding whether this belongs in core WebChat, browser-local settings, command/skill metadata, or plugin Control UI APIs.

options.title: Design shared shortcut metadata first
options.body: Define or extend a maintained command, skill, plugin, or UI-storage metadata contract before building the panel so shortcut discovery has one source of truth.

options.title: Keep shortcuts browser-local
options.body: Implement a Control UI-local shortcut list with local profile storage or import/export, avoiding gateway config while limiting cross-device sharing.

options.title: Defer to plugin entry points
options.body: Hold this until the generic Control UI plugin-panel direction is settled, then make shortcuts a plugin or bundle surface if that boundary wins.

recommendation.title: Design shared shortcut metadata first
recommendation.body: Define or extend a maintained command, skill, plugin, or UI-storage metadata contract before building the panel so shortcut discovery has one source of truth.

likelyOwner.reason: The choice is mainly Control UI/sidebar product direction plus storage/API boundary, and steipete has the strongest recent history on the dashboard chrome/sidebar surface.
